agentic_mapping.canonical_function: multi-app earnings rollup (Gridwise (150k+ monthly drivers, LinkedIn 2026)
agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: every trip logged with platform tag; £/mile + £/hour per platform computed live
agentic_mapping.notes: The platforms ARE the market — the driver has no customers, only channels. Compare them like the restaurant compares Deliveroo vs direct

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: per-trip floor (£/mile incl. dead miles); below floor = decline logged with reason
agentic_mapping.notes: Dead miles wear the car unpaid — floor must include pickup distance, not just trip distance

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: all miles auto-logged; HMRC AMAP applied per trip date (55p/mile to 10k from Apr 2026, then 25p)
agentic_mapping.notes: Verified 2026: most logs miss pickup-to-dropoff gaps. Idle miles are deductible wear.

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: active promos as nodes; progress tracked; shift planned around completion thresholds
agentic_mapping.notes: Quests change the £/hour math mid-shift — model them, don't remember them

agentic_mapping.canonical_function: expense + receipt capture (fuel, wash, tolls, congestion)
agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: receipts scanned to HMRC expense types; congestion/parking auto-flagged by zone
agentic_mapping.notes: London congestion + ULEZ + parking are material — zone-aware flagging

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: weekly % swept to tax pot from net; return pre-filled from trip+expense ledger
agentic_mapping.notes: Gig workers fail on tax surprise, not tax rate — set-aside weekly, file from the ledger

agentic_mapping.agentic_equivalent: golden hours + heatmaps from own history; plan shifts on proven windows
agentic_mapping.notes: 20%+ hourly uplift from driving proven windows vs random hours
